raw_format.policy: Escaping-only copies; original format failures remain failures.

grounding_measurement_limits.lexical_proxy: Legacy claim matching uses claim_id or token Jaccard >=0.35 against English/broad gold claims. Its grounding/leakage numbers are lexical proxies, NOT independently established semantic error rates; retained without threshold changes.

grounded_claim_precision.population: predicted answer claims across benchmark rows
grounded_claim_precision.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted claims supported by gold evidence

grounded_claim_recall.population: gold answer claims across benchmark rows
grounded_claim_recall.aggregation: micro fraction of gold claims recovered with support

unsupported_claim_leakage.population: predicted answer claims across benchmark rows
unsupported_claim_leakage.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted claims that are unsupported

grounding_measurement_limits.separate_source_review: 142 unchanged published answers were independently AI reviewed against question, structured gold and source; 173/173 published claims have runtime support and valid citations. AI review is not human approval.
grounding_measurement_limits.gold_citation_limit: One valid source quote cites a text chunk while exact gold names its table chunk; report 141/142 exact-gold citation precision separately from 142/142 source-coordinate/quote validity.

resolved_issues: 43 derived semester annotations independently source-verified in a separate overlay; frozen v5 preserved.
Exact multiline JSON-array source quotes accepted without joining rows or changing cells.
Named-course credit column proof and Vietnamese minimum-percentage idiom remove 71 false application abstentions.
Citation scoring excludes hidden diagnostics and includes missing gold links; lexical matching remains a separately disclosed proxy.

unmeasured.live_provider_end_to_end_latency: No live generation in owner-selected Chat workflow.
unmeasured.human_labeled_semantic_correctness: AI review is explicitly not human approval.

exit.next_action: A bounded live product run is required to measure provider latency/format reliability; do not send requests automatically. Retain 3 false abstentions as weak segments, no threshold or prompt tuning to manufacture PASS.
